one_line_answer.text: Formative methods are simple, non-graded, in-class activities that give useful feedback.

cites.quote: The techniques are mostly simple, non-graded, in-class activities that give both you and your trainees useful feedback on the teaching learning process.

bangla_explanation: Formative assessment ক্লাস চলাকালীন হয়, নম্বর দেওয়ার জন্য নয়।
এই techniques থেকে বোঝা যায় trainees কতটা শিখছে, তাই learning activities ভালোভাবে plan করা যায়।
Closed questions-এর উত্তর নির্দিষ্ট; open ended questions-এ more detailed response লাগে।
Learning diary-তে trainees লেখে আজ সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কী শিখল আর কী পরিষ্কার হয়নি।

short.prompt: Name the methods of formative assessment.
short.modelAnswer:
Formative assessment methods are simple, non-graded, in-class activities. They are:
1. Written Test (short test items after each topic)
2. Questioning (oral or written; closed and open-ended)
3. Observation and Questioning (during practice tasks)
4. Learning Diary
5. Group Work Assessment

keyPoints.text: Assessment methods are the particular techniques used to gather different types of evidence.
